indoor_roi: full frozen extent_m rectangle centered at the origin

urban_roi.reason: Matches the frozen Table-2 central 60 m evaluation region and bounds Recast independently of generated content

failure_policy: ITT: missing or unusable final geometry contributes zero to all three navigation metrics
notes: No object names are converted into independent object instances.
Road, parking, lawn, and generic ground surfaces are not registered pedestrian walkable regions.
The empty reference is reconstructed only from final native pedestrian/floor surfaces; final navigation is clipped back to that frozen semantic mask.
Crosswalk stripe components are clustered geometrically and filled to their native marking envelope so paint gaps do not become artificial pedestrian gaps.
